spec.scope: Generic ATK gain (feeds all damage), sourced from the unit's OWN final Max HP — an HP→ATK conversion, not a plain ATK% buff.
spec.triggerIdentity: passive ('Activates at the start of battle'), no gate.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoded as plain atkPct 4.05 (percent of own ATK) instead of atkOfMaxHpPct 4.05 (percent of final Max HP) — or a conversion frozen at BASE HP that ignores the skill2 Max HP stage buffs, breaking the kit's core HP→ATK growth loop.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: At t=0 a buffApply with stat 'atkOfMaxHpPct' (value 4.05, targetSlug laplace-ultimate-hero) exists and NO stat 'atkPct' buff with value 4.05 exists from skill1. Growth check: with a patched override whose skill2 stage Max HP values are zeroed, the carry's total damage DROPS versus the committed override — proving the conversion reads live final Max HP, not base HP.
spec.inertness: Must grant zero ATK to allies; must not appear as a maxHpFlat grant (it is ATK, not HP).

spec.scope: Charge-speed only (chargeSpeedPct) — a weapon-state modifier that IS damage (chargeFrames 60 shrinks with stacks → more shots/cycle). Not a damage-stat buff.
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' + stacks up to 5 — but the max-stacks block REMOVES stacks on swap entry, so the real shape is a sawtooth 10→50% rebuilt each cycle, never a permanent 50%.
spec.triggerIdentity: Per full-charge attack by the owner (each base RL charged shot). Should NOT accrue from swap-mode shots (skill2 calls those 'normal attacks'; if they counted as Full Charge the mode would chain-retrigger itself — flag this ambiguity rather than silently deciding).
spec.nearestWrongModel: A passive always-on chargeSpeedPct 50 at max stacks from t=0 (instant-to-max, never reset) — over-credits early-fight charge cadence and erases the per-cycle rebuild after each swap's stack removal.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply events for stat 'chargeSpeedPct' value 10 show stacks incrementing 1..5 across the first five charged shots (none before the first shot fires), and after the swap window ends the stack count restarts from 1 — it is NOT still 5 at the first post-swap charged shot.
spec.inertness: No chargeSpeedPct buff may exist at frame 0 before any shot; allies receive nothing.

spec.kitLine: Changes the weapon: Electric Power, FFC
spec.scope: weaponSwap: per-shot damagePct 9.45, maxAmmo 120, Pierce scoped to SWAP SHOTS ONLY (weaponSwap.hasPierce / gainPierce on the swap window), not the whole-fight top-level hasPierce flag.
spec.durationSemantics: USES-BASED end: 'Deactivation condition: When all rounds are fired' → maxShots 120 with NO real time bound (durationSec, if schema-required, must be ≥ fight length so only ammo exhaustion ends it). There is no 10s window in this kit.
spec.triggerIdentity: Fires when Warm Up reaches max stacks (the 5th full-charge attack), and removes the stacks — an every-5-full-charges cycle trigger (chargeCounter/hitCount-of-charges shape), gated to the unswapped state.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Two coupled misreads: (a) a TIMED swap (e.g. durationSec 10) that truncates the 120 rounds — the single largest damage error available in this kit; (b) top-level hasPierce:true tagging the base RL shots with Pierce for the whole fight.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Count swap-mode shot/damage events per activation: exactly 120 swap shots fire per window regardless of wall-clock time (assert the window's shot count, not its duration). Pierce check: pre-swap base-weapon damage events are NOT pierce-tagged; only shots inside the swap window are.
spec.inertness: Swap shots must not roll the base weapon's charge bucket/charge multiplier; base-weapon shots must never carry Pierce.
spec.evidenceTier: DATAMINED (9.45%, 120 ammo); swap fire cadence / shot economy is CALIBRATED ⚑ (kit-silent — ALWAYS-⚑ field 3, estimate optimistically and flag)

spec.kitLine: When FFC ends: Removes 100% of ammo
spec.scope: Ammo economy of the BASE weapon at swap end — consumeAmmo fraction:1, which empties the returning base magazine and forces an immediate reload (171 frames ≈ 2.85s of downtime per cycle). A weapon-state line that gates shots fired.
spec.triggerIdentity: 'when Electric Power, Fully Full Charge ends' — the schema has no swap-end trigger kind; the honest encoding rides the swap's own last-shot (lastBullet under swapGate 'swapped', or equivalent) so the dump lands exactly when the 120th swap round fires. Flag the workaround explicitly.
spec.nearestWrongModel: The line silently dropped because no trigger kind matches — the base weapon returns with a full magazine and no forced reload, over-crediting uptime by ~2.85s every swap cycle (compounds across the fight).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: A reload event for laplace-ultimate-hero occurs immediately after each swap window's final (120th) swap shot, BEFORE the next base-weapon charged shot — i.e., between swap end and the next base shot there is always a reload; under the dropped-line model the base weapon fires again with no intervening reload.
spec.inertness: Must not consume allies' ammo; must not fire mid-swap.

spec.kitLine: 12 normal attacks in FFC: Over Energy ▲5%
spec.scope: A resource/currency meter (Over Energy pool 0..100), NOT a stat buff — '▲5%' here is meter fill, not a damage stat.
spec.durationSemantics: Pool persists across cycles ('continuously, up to 100%'); consumed only by the stage-advance reset.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount:12 (counts ROUNDS) gated to the swap state (swapGate 'swapped' / 'while in the Electric Power, Fully Full Charge state'). 120 swap rounds → 10 procs → +50% per full swap window → one stage per TWO complete swap windows.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Counting ALL normal attacks including base-weapon shots (ungated hitCount:12) — roughly doubles accrual and reaches high stages far too early; or encoding Over Energy as a stat buff so '5%' leaks into a damage bucket.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: No Over Energy accrual (and hence no stage-1 Max HP buffApply, and no burst additional-damage hit) occurs before the FIRST swap window opens — under the ungated misread, accrual starts from the very first base shots. Quantitative pin: stage 1 is reached only after ~240 swap rounds (two full windows), so the first stage-1 maxHpFlat buffApply must come after the second swap window completes.
spec.inertness: No damage-stat buffApply may be emitted by this line itself; base-weapon shots outside the swap must move the meter by zero.
spec.evidenceTier: DATAMINED (5%/12 hits); time-to-stage trajectory depends on the ⚑ swap cadence — CALIBRATED ⚑ for any wall-clock stage-timing assertion

spec.scope: Self Max HP buffs, CUMULATIVE across stages — 'Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it' → stage totals are 2 / 5 / 12 / 22.5%, not 2 / 3 / 7 / 10.5% standalone. Offensively live via the skill1 atkOfMaxHpPct conversion (own Max HP feeds own conversion — HP/DEF-scaler rule) and the stage counter feeds the burst's ×stage rider.
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' = permanent once a stage is reached; Over Energy meter resets, the STAGE does not.
spec.triggerIdentity: Resource threshold: pool reaches 100 → advance a monotonic stage resource (1..4) + reset pool. Escalating/cumulative effect shape.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Non-cumulative stages (only the newest increment active, stage 3 = 7% instead of 12%) — or Max HP written but treated as inert flavor, severing both consumers (the skill1 ATK conversion and any HP-fed magnitude), making all stage progress damage-dead.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On each stage-up a maxHpFlat (self, caster==target) buffApply is emitted and the CUMULATIVE granted HP after stage 3 equals 12% of base Max HP (not 7%); downstream, per-shot damage events' effective ATK strictly increases across a stage-up frame (the atkOfMaxHpPct conversion re-reads the larger final Max HP).
spec.inertness: Stage never decreases; allies gain no Max HP; the pool reset must not strip previously granted stage HP.

spec.durationSemantics: durationSec 10 (wall-clock 'for 10 sec' — genuine seconds, not rounds).
spec.triggerIdentity: stageEnter stage:3 — 'when entering Burst Stage 3' fires when ANY unit casts a stage-3 burst, NOT only when this unit does (burstCast) and NOT at Full Burst entry (fullBurstEnter, ~22 frames later). In the controlComp fixture (helm is a co-B3), the distinction is live on every rotation helm takes.
spec.nearestWrongModel: burstCast (own casts only) — under-fires on every rotation the co-B3 helm bursts, halving this buff's uptime in any two-B3 comp; second-nearest: fullBurstEnter, which shifts application past the B3-cast frame and past the burst's own instant damage.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In controlComp(carry, true) with helm present, a buffApply stat 'attackDamagePct' value 52.14 on laplace-ultimate-hero occurs at EVERY stage-3 burst cast — including rotations where the burstCast event's caster is helm, not laplace-ultimate-hero. Under the burstCast misread, rotations helm takes emit no such buffApply.
spec.inertness: Must not fire on B1/B2 casts; must not apply to allies.

spec.scope: Plain atkPct (scales own ATK), stacking additively in the ATK bucket with the skill1 flat conversion.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (this unit's own burst) — no clause needed; it sits in the unit's own burst block.
spec.nearestWrongModel: attackDamagePct 63.36 (Damage Up bucket) instead of atkPct (ATK bucket) — same headline number, different bucket, different dilution against the co-active 52.14% Attack Damage buff; or applied at fullBurstEnter so rotations helm takes also grant it.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On each rotation laplace-ultimate-hero bursts, a buffApply stat 'atkPct' value 63.36 (self) is emitted at her burstCast frame; on rotations helm bursts, NO such buffApply exists. Bucket check: the event's stat is atkPct, not attackDamagePct.
spec.inertness: Zero applications on helm's rotations; no ally targets.

spec.scope: flatDamage atkPct 2953.84 in the burst-damage bucket, single boss target (partless scope-lock boss — 'all enemies' collapses to one hit).
spec.durationSemantics: Instant, once per own burst cast.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast. Burst-cast instant damage is FB-EXEMPT (it lands before the Full Burst window opens — no +50% FB major, no FB-entry auras) and takes no +30% range bonus per the rider rules.
spec.nearestWrongModel: The +50% Full Burst major applied to the nuke (fbMajorApplied true) — a ~1,477%-of-ATK phantom per rotation; second-nearest: snapshotting the hit AFTER FB-entry team auras land.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: The burst damage event at each of her casts has inFullBurst false / fbMajorApplied false and mult consistent with 2953.84% of her at-cast final ATK (which INCLUDES her own simultaneous 63.36% atkPct self-buff if the engine applies self-buffs before the hit resolves — assert whichever ordering the event log shows, but assert it explicitly so the ordering is pinned).
spec.inertness: Fires zero times on rotations helm bursts; exactly one hit per cast (no per-enemy multiplication).

spec.scope: A second instant burst hit scaling LINEARLY with the Over Energy STAGE (1..4), i.e. 934.76 / 1869.52 / 2804.28 / 3739.04% — not with the 0–100% meter. flatDamage has no perResource field, so the honest encoding is four stacked burstCast blocks each resourceGate'd at stage min 1/2/3/4, each dealing 934.76% (they sum to stage × 934.76). Flag the workaround.
spec.durationSemantics: Instant, once per own burst cast (per qualifying block).
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast + resourceGate {stage ≥ 1} — hard-gated OFF at stage 0, so the unit's FIRST burst(s) of the fight (before ~two full swap windows complete) must deal NO additional hit. Same FB-exempt/no-range rules as the main nuke.
spec.targetSet: enemy (nearest to crosshair → the single boss)
spec.nearestWrongModel: A flat ungated 934.76% rider on every burst cast — wrong twice: it fires at stage 0 (early-fight over-credit) and it drops the ×stage growth (late-fight under-credit up to 4×). A subtler variant multiplies by the Over Energy PERCENT instead of the stage integer.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Partition her burstCast damage events: casts occurring before the first stage-up emit exactly ONE burst hit (the 2953.84% nuke, no companion); casts after a stage-up emit an additional hit whose summed atkPct equals stage × 934.76 — and that sum strictly increases after each subsequent stage-up. Under the ungated-flat misread, the very first cast already carries a 934.76% companion.
spec.inertness: Zero additional damage at stage 0; the additional hit must not take the +50% FB major.
spec.evidenceTier: DATAMINED (934.76% and the ×stage law); WALL-CLOCK timing of when stages unlock is CALIBRATED ⚑ via the swap-cadence estimate

loadBearingSet: skill1:ATK ▲ 4.05% of final max HP (atkOfMaxHpPct passive)
skill1:weaponSwap Electric Power FFC (9.45%/shot, 120 rounds, uses-based end, swap-scoped Pierce)
skill1:swap-end Removes 100% of ammo (forced base reload)
skill2:stage advance, cumulative Max HP 2/5/12/22.5% (feeds S1 conversion + burst ×stage)
notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in order of damage leverage: (1) TIMING the swap — the engine's weaponSwap idiom is a 10s burst window, but this kit's mode has NO time bound (ends strictly at 120 rounds fired); any durationSec that can expire before round 120 silently truncates the kit's primary damage channel, so the tests must count swap shots per window, never window seconds. (2) The stage machine's plumbing: the Max HP stages are only damage-live THROUGH the skill1 atkOfMaxHpPct conversion — a reviewer who writes the maxHpFlat assertions but never asserts the downstream ATK/damage movement will pass a model where the whole loop is inert. Cumulativity (stage 3 = 12%, not 7%) needs its own assertion. (3) stageEnter vs burstCast for the 52.14% Attack Damage line — the controlComp fixture deliberately contains a co-B3 (helm), which is exactly the configuration where the misread diverges; assert the buff on a helm-cast rotation. (4) Pierce scope: 'Additional Effect: Gains Pierce' lives inside the weapon-change block → swap shots only; a top-level hasPierce:true is the nearest-wrong and over-credits every base charged shot whenever any pierceDamagePct source exists. (5) The swap-end ammo dump has no native trigger kind (schema GAP) — the likeliest silent drop in the whole kit; assert the forced reload between swap end and the next base shot. (6) Ambiguity to reconcile with the driver: whether swap-mode shots count as 'Full Charge attacks' for Warm Up stacking (kit-silent; skill2 calls them 'normal attacks', which argues they do NOT — if the driver stacked Warm Up during the swap, the mode chain-retriggers and the cycle economy is wrong). (7) All wall-clock cadence claims (stage-unlock times, swap windows per fight, cycle period) sit on the ⚑ kit-silent swap fire rate and the reload-forced 171-frame downtime — magnitude assertions should be event-count/ordering-based, not seconds-based, so the tests survive a later cadence re-measurement. (8) Both burst damage lines are burst-cast instant damage → FB-exempt (no +50%, no range); asserting fbMajorApplied false on both is cheap and catches the default-ON trap.
